title: Impact of Artificial Intelligence-supported Triage Systems on Emergency Department Management: A Comparison of Infermedica, Emergency Severity Index, and Manchester Triage System.
summary: The study compared Infermedica with the Emergency Severity Index and Manchester Triage System and reported emergency-department mortality and operational outcomes. These are study-cohort associations and do not establish a causal effect of AI triage.
ai_technology: The study compares the Infermedica AI triage system with ESI and MTS using emergency-department patient data.
organization: Esenyurt Necmi Kadıoğlu State Hospital, Emergency Medicine Service, Istanbul, Türkiye

evidence.tested: Cohort comparison of triage approaches and associated mortality/operational outcomes; design does not establish causal AI benefit.
evidence.unknown: External replication and real-world or clinical benefit were not established by the reviewed study
evidence.ai_role: The study compares the Infermedica AI triage system with ESI and MTS using emergency-department patient data.

source_review.scope: Primary result-bearing material for the stated method, result and evaluation, with bibliographic version information.
